correctness.rationale: The finite odd-degree majority energy decreases strictly unless a state two steps apart repeats, giving eventual period at most two. Fixed configurations reduce exactly to two opposite-ring states plus parity-constrained independent edge sets. The time-pair de Bruijn graph traces exactly \(M^2\)-fixed configurations for all \(n\ge3\); all 256 states and their 400 transitions, six recurrent components and their exact integer characteristic polynomials are reconstructed from the included standalone code. Algebraic root power sums yield the claimed six-residue formulas. Brute-force profiles \(3\le n\le8\) and exact transfer traces \(3\le n\le40\) agree. No inference from partial enumeration to infinity is used.

value.rationale: An exact all-size census of the full terminal orbit structure on the canonical cubic prism social network is a motivated extension of the source’s stable-coloring question beyond cycles. It exhibits a nontrivial spectral separation: fixed configurations grow like \(\varphi^n\), while two-cycle states grow like \(\varphi^{2n}\), and provides exact residue-dependent corrections and orbit counts. This informs persistence of disagreement/blinking patterns, rather than merely recomputing a known static statistic.
